basic_details.job_title: PJTSAU Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior research fellow (srf): M. Sc. in Agriculture / Horticulture

salary_details.details: The post is on a temporary basis and offers a consolidated pay of ₹37,000/- plus HRA.

selection_process: The selection is based on a walk-in interview.
Candidates must attend the walk-in interview directly at the designated venue on the specified date along with required documents.
how_to_apply: Gather xerox copies of all required certificates.
Keep your original certificates ready for verification.
Report in person for the walk-in interview on 23.10.2026 at 10.00 AM.
Attend the interview at the Office of the Senior Scientist & Head, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Ramnagar, Adilabad – 504 002.
important_instructions: Candidates must submit a brief Bio-Data and xerox copies of certificates at the time of the interview. Candidates must bring original certificates for verification. No TA/DA will be provided for candidates appearing for the interview. The position is temporary and lasts upto 31st March, 2027.
